name: Spirula Renderer
definition: A GPU-accelerated Gaussian Splatting renderer implemented as a native Vulkan bridge (librosplat_spirula.so) called via ctypes from Python. It handles tile sorting, Gaussian rasterization, and rendering to Vulkan textures.
summary: Spirula Renderer is a GPU-accelerated Vulkan bridge for Gaussian Splatting that handles tile sorting and rasterization internally, explicitly excluding CUDA, PyTorch, gsplat, or OpenGL paths.
